Crushed NdFeB Granulate for Solid-State Chlorination
fields.description: Crushed and milled NdFeB permanent magnets recovered from end-of-life WEEE. Processed via magnetic extraction, demagnetization and crushing. Ready for SSC rare earth extraction. Batch mass: 6.75 KGM.
fields.cpc_name: Permanent magnets and articles intended to become permanent magnets

fields.name: Whole NdFeB Magnets for Electrochemical Extraction
fields.description: Whole NdFeB permanent magnets extracted and demagnetized from end-of-life WEEE. Supplied as intact magnet units for electrochemical extraction (ECEX) processing. Batch mass: 6.75 KGM.
fields.cpc_name: Permanent magnets and articles intended to become permanent magnets

fields.name: FeNd Bimetallic Catalyst for Ammonia Synthesis (SSC Path)
fields.description: Iron-neodymium bimetallic catalyst for Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis, produced via solid-state chlorination from recycled NdFeB magnets. Batch mass: 1.42 KGM.
fields.upstream_source_material: Crushed NdFeB Granulate for Solid-State Chlorination

fields.name: Nd Polymerization Catalyst (SSC Path)
fields.description: Neodymium-based polymerization catalyst for coordinated polymerisation reactions, produced via SSC separation from recycled NdFeB magnets. Batch mass: 0.50 KGM.
fields.upstream_source_material: Crushed NdFeB Granulate for Solid-State Chlorination

fields.name: Nd API Synthesis Catalyst (SSC Path)
fields.description: Neodymium catalyst for pharmaceutical API synthesis via coupling reactions, produced via SSC separation from recycled NdFeB magnets. Batch mass: 0.030 KGM.
fields.upstream_source_material: Crushed NdFeB Granulate for Solid-State Chlorination

fields.name: Nd Suzuki Reaction Catalyst (SSC Path)
fields.description: Neodymium catalyst for Suzuki-Miyaura cross-coupling reactions in organic synthesis, produced via SSC separation from recycled NdFeB magnets. Batch mass: 0.020 KGM.
fields.upstream_source_material: Crushed NdFeB Granulate for Solid-State Chlorination

fields.name: FeNd Alloy for Ammonia Fertilizer Production (SSC Path)
fields.description: Iron-neodymium alloy intermediate for catalytic ammonia production (Haber-Bosch process) targeting fertilizer applications, derived from SSC separation of recycled NdFeB magnets. Batch mass: 2.5 KGM.
fields.upstream_source_material: Crushed NdFeB Granulate for Solid-State Chlorination

fields.name: FeNd Bimetallic Catalyst for Ammonia Synthesis (ECEX Path)
fields.description: Iron-neodymium bimetallic catalyst for Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis, produced via electrochemical extraction from recycled NdFeB magnets. Batch mass: 1.37 KGM.
fields.upstream_source_material: Whole NdFeB Magnets for Electrochemical Extraction

fields.name: Nd Polymerization Catalyst (ECEX Path)
fields.description: Neodymium-based polymerization catalyst for coordinated polymerisation reactions, produced via electrochemical extraction from recycled NdFeB magnets. Batch mass: 0.46 KGM.
fields.upstream_source_material: Whole NdFeB Magnets for Electrochemical Extraction

fields.name: Nd API Synthesis Catalyst (ECEX Path)
fields.description: Neodymium catalyst for pharmaceutical API synthesis via coupling reactions, produced via electrochemical extraction from recycled NdFeB magnets. Batch mass: 0.029 KGM.
fields.upstream_source_material: Whole NdFeB Magnets for Electrochemical Extraction

fields.name: Nd Suzuki Reaction Catalyst (ECEX Path)
fields.description: Neodymium catalyst for Suzuki-Miyaura cross-coupling reactions in organic synthesis, produced via electrochemical extraction from recycled NdFeB magnets. Batch mass: 0.028 KGM.
fields.upstream_source_material: Whole NdFeB Magnets for Electrochemical Extraction

fields.name: Green Fertilizer (Nitrogen, NH3-derived)
fields.description: Nitrogen-based fertilizer produced by blending the FeNd/ammonia alloy recovered from SSC upcycling with mineral and compost bulking additives. Batch mass: 20 KGM (2.5 KGM recovered feedstock + 20 KGM additives, with process loss from moisture off-gassing during blending).
fields.upstream_source_material: FeNd Alloy for Ammonia Fertilizer Production (SSC Path)

fields.name: Rare earth extraction from EOL WEEE assessment
fields.description: Third-party conformity assessment of Rare Earth Recycling Ltd. against R2:2013 Responsible Recycling Standard for responsible collection, recovery and recycling of end-of-life electronics.

fields.name: Rare earth upcycling environmental management assessment
fields.description: Third-party conformity assessment of Rare Earth Upcycling Ltd. against ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management Systems standard, covering both SSC and ECEX processing lines.

fields.name: Green fertilizer CE conformity assessment
fields.description: Third-party conformity assessment of GreenFert Innovations SAS fertilizer production against Regulation (EU) 2019/1009 (Fertilising Products Regulation), covering nutrient content declaration, contaminant limits and recovered-material input verification for nitrogen fertilizer derived from recovered ammonia.

fields.name: WEEE Collection, Extraction and Processing — SSC Path
fields.description: Collection of 1000 kg end-of-life WEEE (Jul 15), magnetic separation and extraction of NdFeB magnets (6.81 KGM, Jul 17), demagnetization and crushing to produce crushed NdFeB granulate (6.75 KGM) for solid-state chlorination.

fields.name: Shipment of Crushed NdFeB Granulate to Upcycler — SSC Path
fields.description: Shipment of 6.7 KGM crushed NdFeB granulate (batch NDFEB-GRAN-2024-07-003) to Rare Earth Upcycling Ltd. for SSC processing. Quality control sample (0.05 KGM) retained at origin.
fields.destination_facility_name: Rare Earth Upcycling Ltd. — Main Facility

fields.name: WEEE Collection, Extraction and Processing — ECEX Path
fields.description: Collection of 1000 kg end-of-life WEEE (Aug 15), magnetic separation and extraction of NdFeB magnets (6.81 KGM, Aug 17), demagnetization to produce whole NdFeB magnets (6.75 KGM) for electrochemical extraction.

fields.name: Shipment of Whole NdFeB Magnets to Upcycler — ECEX Path
fields.description: Shipment of 6.7 KGM whole NdFeB magnets (batch NDFEB-MAG-2024-08-004) to Rare Earth Upcycling Ltd. for ECEX processing. Quality control sample (0.05 KGM) retained at origin.
fields.destination_facility_name: Rare Earth Upcycling Ltd. — Main Facility

fields.name: SSC Chlorination, Separation and Downstream Production
fields.description: Rare earth separation via solid-state chlorination (SSC): chlorination reaction (Jul 21) and chromatographic separation (Jul 22), producing 5 output streams from 6.7 KGM crushed NdFeB input: FeNd catalyst (1.42 KGM), Nd polymerization catalyst (0.50 KGM), Nd API synthesis catalyst (0.030 KGM), Nd Suzuki catalyst (0.020 KGM), FeNd alloy for ammonia/fertilizer production (2.5 KGM).

fields.name: ECEX Electrochemical Extraction, Separation and Downstream Production
fields.description: Rare earth separation via electrochemical extraction: electrochemical dissolution of whole magnets (Aug 22) and separation (Aug 23), producing 4 output streams from 6.7 KGM whole NdFeB input: FeNd catalyst (1.37 KGM), Nd polymerization catalyst (0.46 KGM), Nd API synthesis catalyst (0.029 KGM), Nd Suzuki catalyst (0.028 KGM).

fields.name: Shipment of FeNd/Ammonia Alloy to GreenFert — SSC Path
fields.description: Shipment of 2.5 KGM FeNd alloy for ammonia fertilizer production (batch SSC-NH3-FERT-2024-07-001) from Rare Earth Upcycling Ltd. to GreenFert Innovations SAS for fertilizer production.

fields.name: Fertilizer Blending Process — Green Fertilizer Production
fields.description: Blending of 2.5 KGM FeNd/ammonia alloy recovered from SSC upcycling with mineral and compost bulking additives to produce 20 KGM of Green Fertilizer at GreenFert Innovations SAS.
